pairs.subject: metric-surface-contract
pairs.evidence: app/_components/ScoreBadge.tsx:39 These components only draw an already-computed candidate score in the recruiter's browser and export nothing to a time-series store or other outside consumer, so the subject's precondition (a published metric surface) does not hold here; a search of the 12 source files and of app/_components for prometheus, prom-client, histogram and opentelemetry found nothing, and no metrics exporter exists in package.json or app/.

techniques.evidence: app/_components/ScoreDial.tsx:40 The only timing here drives a requestAnimationFrame count-up animation. It is not instrumentation of a latency-critical serving loop.
app/_components/Meter.tsx:25 The percentage is a display value for a human reader, not an exported counter or gauge that downstream consumers fold over windows.
app/_components/AnalysisProgress.tsx:39 A wall-clock elapsed counter shown to the user. No duration metric is published, so the monotonic-clock rule for exported intervals has nothing to bind.
